codeReview.summary: The feature implementation covers the required behavior: geolocated thumbnail markers via AdvancedMarkerElement, single InfoWindow selection, date-grouped chronological gallery, gallery/map toggle without remounting the map, and empty-state handling with null-geolocation photos excluded from markers. No blocking regressions were found in the reviewed diff.

issues.description: Date heading assertions hard-code English locale output (e.g., 'Monday, March 23, 2026'), which can be flaky across locales/timezones. Prefer deterministic date-format mocking or assertions that do not depend on localized full strings.

Photo cards are click-only <div> elements without keyboard handlers/semantics, so gallery photo opening is not keyboard-accessible. Consider using a semantic <button> or adding keyboard interaction handlers and roles.

sharedStateObservations.observation: fullstack-worker procedure and adherence reporting appear misaligned: transcript shows implementation edits before test creation and only targeted test execution, while SKILL.md requires TDD plus full-suite vitest and manual interactive checks.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: SKILL.md sections 'Write Tests First (TDD)', 'Run Validators' (npx vitest run --reporter=verbose), and 'Manual Verification'; transcript skeleton shows edits to PhotoMarkers/TripDetail before creating PhotoGallery.test.tsx, and handoff verification lists only targeted vitest with interactiveChecks: [].

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission shared-state docs do not capture UI theme conventions, leading to style drift decisions in feature work.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: mission AGENTS.md and .factory/library/*.md contain no theme guidance; this feature introduced many light-theme classes (e.g., src/components/PhotoGallery.tsx:52,70,102 and src/pages/TripDetail.tsx:232,252-269), making conventions ambiguous for future workers.
